summary: Feed s074_single to NDR is degraded: 13.2% duplicate packets (343/2595) exceeds 5% threshold. All other checks (one-way, truncated, packet drops, tool overload, encrypted share, missing VLAN, tunnel, oversize) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is aggregating overlapping capture points (e.g., multiple SPANs/TAPs covering the same link or both sides of an aggregation) without deduplication, delivering the same packet twice to the single NDR tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR wastes CPU/storage on 13.2% redundant packets, inflates flow counts and can skew behavioral analytics/detection; reduces effective 10G inspection capacity despite needing full payload and both directions.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication to drop identical packets seen within a short window before forwarding to the NDR, restoring complete but non-redundant traffic for accurate detection coverage.
